note: THE EVENTS REMODEL. Recurring events (a series with runs, Eden's model), Eden one-at-a-time registration questions, an 'open to anyone' members-only gate, and enforcement of the registration deadline that was previously stored but never read. Every new field (recurrence, timeZone, registrationQuestions, openToAnyone on the event; runDate, answers on the registration) is optional and defaults to the existing behaviour, so no prior event or registration changes shape. The recurrence math lives in one new pure module, src/lib/events/recurrence.ts, so nothing else re-derives a schedule; capacity for a recurring event is counted PER RUN via registrationMatchesRun, and a registration with no runDate (every row written before this ticket) still matches the single implicit run. No firestore.rules or firestore.indexes.json change: the new fields carry no field-level validation today and every new/changed query is still a single-field where, filtered or counted in memory.

entries.why: FOUR ADDITIONS, EACH GATED SO AN EXISTING EVENT NEVER REACHES THE NEW CODE. (1) `event.openToAnyone === false` now requires a verified token whose tenantId matches, checked right after the existing published+registrationEnabled gate — absent/true (every event today) is unchanged. (2) `event.registrationDeadline`, stored since before this ticket but never read here, now 410s once it has passed. (3) A recurring event (`event.recurrence` present) requires a `runDate` in the body, validated against `expandRuns` so a cancelled or invented date 410s instead of silently taking a seat; a non-recurring event never reaches this branch. (4) `validateAnswers` runs against `event.registrationQuestions` (empty/absent means no questions and no validation) and the capacity query's `soldForType` reduce now also calls `registrationMatchesRun(r.runDate, targetRunDate)`, which is true for every existing registration (no runDate) against every non-recurring event (targetRunDate null) — so capacity counting for every event that existed before this ticket is unchanged. The Stripe direct-charge branch, the discount-code accounting, the automated SMS and the confirmation email are untouched.

A PURE APPEND, AND NO READ OR QUERY SHAPE MOVED. `Event` gains optional `recurrence`, `timeZone`, `registrationQuestions` and `openToAnyone`; `Registration` gains optional `runDate` and `answers`; `Registration.status` gains the two legacy-but-already-written literal members `'pending_payment'` and `'expired'` that the type previously omitted even though the webhook and the Stripe paid-ticket branch already wrote them, which is a type-accuracy fix with no runtime effect. New `RecurrenceRule` and `RegistrationQuestion` interfaces are exported for `src/lib/events/recurrence.ts` and the submit route to import. `useEvents`' `orderBy('startDate','desc').limit(100)`, `useEvent`'s `get`, and `useEventRegistrations`' single-field `where('eventId', ...)` + client-side sort are byte-identical.

THE EDEN CREATE POPUP AND THE RECURRENCE/QUESTIONS UI, WITH NO FIRESTORE PATH MOVED. RE-RECORDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — every prior accepted digest (#522, THE-326, THE-345, THE-346, THE-351, THE-355, THE-368, THE-377) stays accepted above. What moved: the create/edit form is now a shadcn Dialog instead of a full page (Eden's 'New event' is a single popup); 'Where' became a ToggleGroup (In person/Online) with a keyless OpenStreetMap preview iframe for an in-person address, skipped under `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test'` the same way AdminDashboard.tsx already skips a render for tests; Time zone (Select) and Repeats/Ends (Select + RadioGroup, building an optional `recurrence` object) were added after the date fields; Open to anyone (Switch) was added; the payment-link picker became a bespoke single-select RadioGroup — Matei: 'make the admin create form pick ONE link' — replacing the shared checkbox `PaymentLinkPicker` ON THIS SCREEN ONLY (the campaign giving widget keeps it unchanged, still multi-select) while still writing `paymentProviders` as a `string[]` through the same `readEventProviderIds`; a Registration Questions builder (short/long/choice, required toggle, reorder, max 10, writing `form.registrationQuestions`) was added beside Discount Codes; `handleSave`/`openEdit`/`openCreate` gained the new fields (`recurrence`, `timeZone`, `registrationQuestions`, `openToAnyone`) alongside every existing one, untouched; the list view gained an Upcoming/Drafts/Past `PageTabs` filter above the cards and an Eden 'Plan your first event' `Empty` state. NO FIRESTORE PATH MOVED: every new field writes onto the SAME `tenants/{id}/events/{id}` document this screen always wrote (`firestorePathsOf` is unchanged); no new collection, read or write was added. THE FOUNDER'S STRUCTURAL DECISIONS ARE UNCHANGED: the Check In control is still gated on `r.status === 'confirmed'` alone, the payment flag still renders beside it, the CSV export, the registration URL shape, confirmDelete, and the month view's lazy mount are all byte-identical. Full accounting of the colour and mobile-layer sweep deltas this touches is in `THE_379_PRIMITIVE_CLASSES`, `THE_379_ADDED_COLOURS`, `THE_379_REMOVED_COLOURS`, `THE_379_MOBILE_TOKENS` and `THE_379_UNPREFIXED_HEIGHTS` in `AdminMinistry.desktop-layout.test.tsx`, and in `THE_308_EVENTS`'s re-recorded digest there.

LUMA ADDITIONS — A RUN PICKER, A MAP, SPOTS LEFT, ONE-AT-A-TIME QUESTIONS, A MEMBERS-ONLY NOTICE AND ADD-TO-CALENDAR — NONE OF WHICH TOUCH THE PAYMENT-CLAIM MACHINERY THE-351/355/359 OWN. A recurring event (`event.recurrence` present, absent on every event before this ticket) shows a run picker built from the SAME pure `expandRuns` the admin form and the submit route use, so it can never offer a date the server would reject; the chosen `runDate` is sent in the submit payload and used for the .ics file's own time. A keyless OpenStreetMap preview renders under the location line for an in-person event, skipped under `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test'` for the identical reason AdminEvents.tsx's own map preview is. `event.spotsLeftByTicket`, computed server-side in page.tsx the same way the submit route counts capacity (confirmed seats only, non-recurring events only), replaces the old static 'Limited spots' line with a live count where one exists, falling back to the old wording everywhere else — so no existing event's ticket row reads differently than before. `event.registrationQuestions` (empty/absent on every existing event) renders one at a time with Back/Next and the same required-but-blank rejection the server's `validateAnswers` enforces, gating the coupon/summary/submit section behind `questionsDone` — which is `true` immediately when there are no questions, so every existing event's flow from ticket selection straight to submit is UNCHANGED. `event.openToAnyone === false` (absent/true means open, matching every event before this ticket) shows a sign-in notice and disables the submit button for a logged-out visitor — the server's own `openToAnyone` gate in the submit route is the authoritative check; this is the honest heads-up, not a second enforcement. 'Add to calendar' builds an RFC 5545 .ics client-side (no new dependency, no server round trip) for a confirmed non-waitlisted ticket. THE PAYMENT CLAIM FLOW, THE STRIPE-RETURN BRANCH, THE DISCOUNT LOOKUP, THE CAPACITY/WAITLIST LOGIC, THE REGISTRATION URL AND EVERY STRING THE-351/355/359 OWN ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL — none of this ticket's additions sit inside `data-public-payment-note`, so THE-351's positional forbidden-phrase guard still finds exactly what it found before.

SERIALIZES THE FOUR NEW OPTIONAL EVENT FIELDS AND COMPUTES SPOTS LEFT, NOTHING ELSE. `recurrence`, `timeZone`, `registrationQuestions` and `openToAnyone` are passed through with the same absent-means-default fallback as every existing field (`data.recurrence || null`, `data.openToAnyone ?? true`). `spotsLeftByTicket` is a NEW single-field query — `tenants/{id}/registrations` filtered by `eventId`, the exact same query/path the submit route already runs for the same reason — counted in memory and only when the event is NOT recurring (a recurring event's capacity is per-run and a visitor has not picked one yet; the submit route still enforces the real per-run capacity regardless of what this page shows). No composite index: single `where`, filtered and summed client-side in the route handler. The tenant resolution, the draft/cancelled 404 gate, the discountCodes withholding and the existing payOptions resolution (THE-355) are byte-identical.

EDEN'S UPCOMING/GOING/PAST, AND NOTHING ABOUT THE TICKET OR ITS PAYMENT STATE. A new `Tabs`/`TabsList`/`TabsTrigger` row under the header switches between three row sets: `rows` (the existing upcoming read, unchanged — still every published tenant event ordered by `startDate` desc, limit 100, plus any ticketed event not already in that page), `goingRows` (the same `rows` narrowed to `!!r.ticket`, no new read), and `pastRows` (built from a new `allTickets` state var — the SAME `/api/my-registrations` response this screen already fetched, now also kept in full rather than only turned into `ticketByEvent` — filtered to `event.startMillis < todayMs` and mapped into the same `EventRow` shape the upcoming list already renders). NO NEW FETCH, NO NEW FIRESTORE PATH: `allTickets` is populated from the SAME API response `ticketByEvent` already was, so `firestorePathsOf`-equivalent reasoning holds unchanged. THE DEFAULT TAB IS 'upcoming', rendering the exact same list a visitor saw before this ticket, so nothing about the existing behaviour moved for anyone who never touches the new tabs. `TicketPaymentPanel`, `TicketModal`, the QR-withholding gate, the claim button and every string THE-351/THE-359 own are byte-identical — none of this ticket's changes touch them.
